root.statement_template: There exists a relational carrier C with geometric structure G, admissible dynamics D and observable maps O whose realizations recover the declared physical target regimes T, agree across shared regimes, satisfy the declared empirical tests E and impose falsifiable constraints F.
root.quantifier_policy: One common witness (C,G,D,O) across declared targets, not a separately chosen carrier for each target.
root.all_physics_policy: All physics is the motivating ambition. A testable claim requires an explicit versioned target set; closure over that set is not universal closure over every physical phenomenon.

obligations.statement_template: Specify and construct C, G and admissible D, including composition, constraints, and the provenance of geometry.
For every declared target in T, construct a realization from the same carrier witness and prove the stated recovery laws in its declared regime.
On every declared overlap, prove that sector transports and shared observable maps agree at the required stratum while preserving the common witness.
Meet each declared empirical test E with explicit calibration, nuisance parameters, uncertainty, and separation of fitting from validation inputs.
State and test constraints F that exclude alternatives or predict held-out observations rather than permitting arbitrary adapters or per-target choices.

link_contract.admission_rule: An admitted proof-supplying link requires live scoped outcome resolution and reviewed scope/witness transport. A negative branch result only obstructs its stated realization unless a separate exhaustive argument is proved.

boundary: Local structure scaffold, not a proof attempt, logical conjunction theorem, physical claim, or external graph mutation. Existing nets are not linked by name similarity.
